definition: A plan diagram drawn not for this style but for one it answers to: an ancestor it inherits its kit from, or a family it is filed under. Its own line built it, so it is among the style's plan types.
basis: Our wording of the composer's nativity relation. build/compose.py, nativity: "Lineage means the diagram was drawn for a style this one answers to, an ancestor it inherits its kit from or a container it is a member of, and not for this style itself."; mcp_server/core.py, list_partis: "Native and lineage partis are listed; a borrowed one only with `include_borrowed`, because a style's plan types are the diagrams its own line was drawn with."
